summary.text: Monica R. Martinez is a Democratic member of the New York State Senate who has represented District 4 since January 2023 and is running for re-election on the Democratic and Working Families Party lines.
She previously worked as an assistant principal and as a deputy regional director in the state parks department.

paragraphs.text: Monica Martinez earned a B.A. in history from Binghamton University in 1999 and a master's degree in secondary social studies education from New York University in 2000, according to Ballotpedia.

Her career experience includes work as an assistant principal at Brentwood Middle School and as a deputy regional director in the New York State Parks, Recreation and Historic Preservation department.

She took office in the State Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Philip Boyle, and her 2025 to 2026 committee assignments include Aging, Education, Transportation, and Commerce, Economic Development and Small Business.
